what: The transcript_green work queue for the 103 staged compile-only units, ranked by what it actually costs to produce evidence: units with exports MEASURED firing in their scenario first (a scout already proved a boot will hit them), then units by the fraction of their exports the capture plan can reach at all.
is_not: Not a verification result and not an eligibility ceiling. `capturable` means capture_transcript.py `sites` produced a plan with no refusal; `measured` means a scout on the live console counted entry hits. Neither is a claim about behaviour.
